describe.description: A single quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background, with an arched back and body held low on four stout limbs. The animal has an elongated tapered snout, a small rounded ear, and a long thick tapering tail resting on the ground behind it. Most of the dorsal surface, the top of the head, the outer sides of the limbs, and the tail are covered in overlapping dark brown to gray keratinous scales with lighter edges and fine ridged texture. Large irregular patches of pale pink, wrinkled bare skin are exposed where scales are absent on the mid-back, the mid-flank above the foreleg, and the lower rump and inner hindquarter. The ventral surface and lower limbs show pale gray-brown skin, and the feet bear long curved dark claws. The overall posture is standing/walking with all four feet in contact with the ground.

describe.description: A bulky quadrupedal creature shown in right-side profile walking to the right, with a highly arched rounded back, a small elongated head tapering to a blunt snout, four short stout limbs ending in long curved claws, and a long tapering tail extending behind. Most of the back, sides, top of the head, outer limbs and tail are covered in overlapping dark gray-brown keratinous scales, interrupted by several large smooth pale pink hairless swollen-looking bare patches on the mid-back, mid-flank and rear, with a pale wrinkled underbelly and gray-brown wrinkled skin on the face and feet.
